name: brine-theme
description: Niraula EduMedia Aternos-style theme for the Pterodactyl Panel user area - navy/gold brand, self-hosted fonts, fixed sidebar shell, redesigned dashboard, login, console and file manager. Admin area, favicon and page title untouched.

files.note: Emits every colour utility as rgb(var(--pt-*)); adds navy/gold brand ramps and aliases blue/primary to navy and cyan to gold
Palette stylesheet link and the pre-paint light/dark bootstrap; title, favicon and meta tags stay stock
Theme read/write/subscribe helpers shared by the panel UI
Light/dark toggle button used in the panel topbar
Brand tokens, self-hosted @font-face, shell/auth/dashboard/console/file-manager styles and light-mode fixes
Montserrat variable font, self-hosted body typeface
Playfair Display variable font, self-hosted heading typeface
Brand mark used by the sidebar and the login screen
Fixed sidebar + sticky topbar + mobile drawer shell for dashboard and server routes
Aternos-style sidebar with brand block, permission-filtered server/account navigation and user footer
Rewritten as the shell topbar: burger, page title, search, theme toggle, admin link and avatar menu
Wraps the dashboard in AppShell and drops the legacy SubNavigation
Wraps server routes in AppShell and drops the legacy SubNavigation
Centres the redesigned Niraula login card
Redesigned login card: navy masthead with brand emblem, gold rule, Playfair heading and footer
Passes the Niraula heading and subtitle to the redesigned login card
Same treatment for the 2FA checkpoint screen
Same treatment for the password recovery screen
Same treatment for the password reset screen
Branded hero header with welcome stats, section title and empty state
Server cards with status/allocation chips, CPU/MEM/DISK stat blocks and colour bars
Adds the shared Niraula EduMedia footer
Sharp 3px buttons with uppercase letter-spaced labels
Branded console header with status chip and gold call-to-action power button
Marks the Start button for the gold call-to-action treatment
Terminal chrome: window bar, dots, title and command hint
Navy-black terminal, neutral stat cards and gold accents
Console detail stat blocks re-skinned to neutral cards with gold icons
Resolves chart palette through ptColor()
Resolves chart grid/tick/line colours through ptColor()
Toolbar layout and branded empty state
Navy path bar with gold links and monospaced type
Card-style file rows with icon tiles, size and modified columns
File manager row, tile, empty-state and mass-action styles
Branded selection bar with selection counter
